dev_environment: Development PC (Xeon + GTX 1070) without YuE2 or Seed-VC: stand-in runtime with FFmpeg 8.1.1, Python 3.11, numpy/scipy/soundfile/librosa and placeholder YuE2 files; a stand-in Seed-VC inference.py with the pinned interface runs under the real seedvc_runner.py.

voice_engine.name: Seed-VC v1 singing model (44.1 kHz, F0-conditioned, zero-shot)

voice_checks: Settings: shared and per-song {versions: ten switches A-J, octave} validation; job-level voice per version letter; whole-octave rule (>= 7 semitones apart, clamped to one octave); unusable stored shapes fall back to the default.
Analysis: phrases split at gaps and at the quietest point of long regions; the reference clip drops pauses and needs 3 s of singing; pYIN median pitch.

Runner with a stand-in engine: models load once, one call per phrase with F0 conditioning, no automatic pitch matching, octave, steps, CFG and fp16 as planned; CPU refused without the test flag; self-test.

Conversion: phrases return to their exact positions, silence stays silent, loudness matches the generated vocal, remix with the generated accompaniment, generated.wav unchanged, engine errors reported, no-vocal results kept and labelled.

Pipeline: preflight fails before any stage when the engine is missing; reference from original-stems, or from the un-shifted original (reference-stems) after a key change; A/B reuse copies reference-stems.

HTTP: settings and per-song persistence, A/B mapping, preserve and instrumental ignore voice swap, whole batch rejected when the engine is missing, names with Original Voice (kept by derived key/tempo works), voice_info for finished works.
Release validation passes only when every required benchmark passed.
installer_checks: Both PowerShell scripts parse without errors.

Offline install dry run with a fake bundle: checksum check, base Python from ace-env, separate venv, offline pip and self-test call; a failed self-test leaves no install.json; existing installs need -Replace; damaged files are refused.

Every pinned package exists for 64-bit Python 3.11 on Windows (PyPI and the PyTorch cu128 index were queried, nothing downloaded); julius and randomname are source-only and are built into wheels by seedvc-download.ps1.
